newsitem.title: USA: RPM Inc completes sale of Swiggle unit.
newsitem.headline: RPM Inc completes sale of Swiggle unit.

text.p: RPM Inc on Monday said it completed the sale of its Tremco Inc subisidiary's Swiggle Insulating Glass unit to Kirtland Capital Partners, a Cleveland investment firm, for $107 million.
RPM will use proceeds of the sale to repay long-term debt. Together with other divestitures of non-core product lines, it reduces the company's long-term debt by about $140 million.
The company said the deal would not affect earnings and left its Tremco unit with an annual revenue base of about $250 million.
"Tremco will have a very positive effect on RPM's 1998 fiscal year, which began June 1, 1997, with increasing contributions to sales and earnings in future fiscal years," RPM said in a statement.
The sale of the Swiggle business substantially completes a restructuring associated with RPM's acquisition of Tremco from B.F. Goodrich Co.
